pipeline.title: Active pipeline
pipeline.waitCloud: The cloud confirms writes with a delay — the file may appear there after a few minutes.

connections.confirmRemove: Remove this connection? Transfer history is kept.
connections.oauthKeysNote: Keys appear after creating the app — paste them above, then click “Sign in via browser”.
connections.oauthNeedKeys: This provider requires keys of your own OAuth app. Create it with the button below and enter Client ID / Client Secret — then the browser will open automatically.
connections.registerStep3: Copy Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below
connections.oauthOpenFailed: Could not open the browser automatically — open the authorization page manually:
connections.oauthBlocked: The browser blocked the popup — open the authorization page manually:
connections.yandexTokenHint: Paste the Yandex.Disk OAuth token. To get one: create an app and request a token per the official guide.
connections.instrOAuth: 1. Click “Sign in via browser” — the provider page opens in the selected browser. 2. Sign in and grant access. 3. Return to the app — it will detect success automatically.
connections.instrToken: 1. Create a Yandex.Disk app (see the link below). 2. Request an OAuth token and copy it. 3. Paste the token above.
connections.instrPassword: 1. For Mail.ru create an app password in your account settings. 2. Enter login and app password. 3. The WebDAV URL is usually pre-filled.
connections.instrKeys: Create Access/Secret keys in your S3 provider panel and set the region/endpoint.
connections.instrHost: Enter the FTP/SFTP host and port, login and password.
connections.clientHint: This provider needs your own OAuth application keys
connections.regDrive1: Enable the Google Drive API: console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Library → “Google Drive API” → Enable (button below)
connections.regDrive2: On the Credentials page there are 3 authorization types: API key, OAuth client, service account. You need the OAuth Client ID
connections.regDrive3: Create an OAuth Client ID of type “Desktop app”, redirect URI: {{redirect}}
connections.regDrive4: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below
connections.regDrive5: Scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive — full access to your files
connections.regOnedrive1: App registration: Azure portal → App registrations → New registration
connections.regOnedrive2: Supported account types: “Personal Microsoft accounts” (for personal OneDrive); Redirect URI (Web): {{redirect}}
connections.regOnedrive3: API permissions → Microsoft Graph → Delegated permissions → add Files.ReadWrite and offline_access
connections.regOnedrive4: Grant admin consent if the account is organizational
connections.regOnedrive5: Overview → Application (client) ID; Certificates & secrets → New client secret → copy both values
connections.regYandex2: No redirect URL is needed — Yandex shows the code on https://oauth.yandex.ru/verification_code
connections.regYandex3: Copy Client ID and Client Secret below (scopes cloud_api:disk.read / disk.write / disk.info are needed)
connections.scope_drive: OAuth scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive — full access to your files (read and write). The token refreshes automatically.
connections.scope_onedrive: Microsoft Graph, delegated permissions: Files.ReadWrite (read/write files) and offline_access (token refresh).
connections.scope_yandex: Yandex.Disk: cloud_api:disk.read (read files), cloud_api:disk.write (upload), cloud_api:disk.info (disk info).
connections.scope_generic: Permissions needed to read the source and write to the cloud.
connections.registerStep2Yandex: No redirect URL is needed — Yandex shows the code on https://oauth.yandex.ru/verification_code

onboarding.title: Welcome to StreamDrop
onboarding.subtitle: Files travel from the network into the cloud through RAM — no disk involved
onboarding.step0Body: Transfers need external utilities. Install rclone — without it streaming is impossible.
onboarding.step1Body: Add Mail.ru, Yandex.Disk, Google Drive or another storage in the connections panel.
onboarding.step2Body: StreamDrop checks the file name, size and type before the transfer starts.
onboarding.step3Body: Pick a destination folder and press Start direct stream. You can close the tab.

errors.inspect_html_source: The source returned HTML — choose yt-dlp or a profile with cookies
errors.inspect_not_head_supported: The source supports neither HEAD nor Range requests
errors.auth_client_not_enabled: The app is not enabled for personal Microsoft accounts. In Azure Portal → App registrations → your app → Authentication → Supported account types choose “Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts”, then create a new Client Secret and enter it again.
errors.cloud_google_api_disabled: The Google Drive API is not enabled in your project. Enable it at console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/drive.googleapis.com and wait a couple of minutes.
errors.cloud_quota_exceeded: Not enough space in the cloud
errors.cloud_cleanup_failed: Could not remove the incomplete fragment
errors.telegram_chat_invalid: A numeric user ID is required (e.g. 123456789), not the bot's username. Get your ID via @userinfobot.
errors.local_auth_required: The interface session has expired — reloading the page
